speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Good evening everyone. Hope you're well. We'll  take a show of hands for questions, please.  
Paul's got the mic somewhere to start. Richard.  Hi, Pep. I just wondered about your reaction and,  
in particular, what you thought of Phil Foden's  performance and the way he created the first goal.  
This type of game, low block, they defend  so well. Since Oliver is here, it is quite  
similar to the final. They defend really, really  well, transitions and set pieces. And you need  
the quality, the spark, the talent, the vision,  something that is not on the tactical boards,  
it is not in the meetings, it is not in the  videos, it is not even in the training. It is  
receiving the ball in small spaces and creating  something that just the good players can deliver.  
I am really pleased for him. And his performance  as a whole, did you feel it is the best he has  
played for quite a while? Yeah, because of  the impact. What I appreciate the most is the  
fact that he played as a holding midfielder in a  position he is not used to. But in the last game,  
the last 20, 25 minutes against Brentford, he  played there and was outstanding. Because it  
is not about he is lazy or does not run. Running,  pressing all the time, Phil, that is unique. But  
he helped a lot Bernie in that position. And after  that, with the ball, we went to the box, because  
Phil close to the box is just unique. Obviously,  difficult to balance your team selection tonight  
given the FA Cup final is coming up. Is it fair to  say you ticked both boxes by giving some players a  
rest but also keeping the pressure on Arsenal?  Well, of course there is the FA Cup final,  
but after Bournemouth. Well, three days, three  days. Chelsea have been all week at home training,  
preparing the final. We have to travel to London,  they will be at home with their wives and kids. So  
that is fatigue, and fatigue, and fatigue. And  of course, I have full confidence in all the  
squad. Imagine the players who did not play today,  and they are so good. So yeah, I thought that we  
needed energy and Savinho had an incredible game,  the two strikers Antoine and Omar as well. Always  
scoring goals, always they score when they are  close. And yeah, in general it was really, really  
good against a team that always creates problems.  Really pleased. Three goals against Brentford,  
three goals here. I cannot ask for more. And now  just incredible focus, and we have two rests and  
focus on the final. So it is a pleasure to go to  the cathedral again of English football to play  
the final. Hopefully the result will be better  than the last two times. You said that you can  
only concentrate on the things that you do. How  important is it that you got a result and you  
get... Yeah, of course. We know against Brentford  today, if we lose, we have nothing to do, but to  
start to bring the hope for the last game. But I  would say, wow, the next contender is Bournemouth.  
Look at what they are doing this season, and at  home all season, and after Aston Villa. So they  
are not easy ones. But just focus on that and we  see what happens, Bournemouth and the last ones.  
Hi, Pep. Can I ask about Bernardo playing in that  deeper role today, that he has done numerous times  
before, but generally more further forward.  How difficult is it to find players with that  
level of versatility in the modern game, and how  difficult will he be to replace? Bernie? I liked a  
lot the last game he played against Brentford. He  gave us defensively his intuition. I do not know  
what happened, transition is there, second ball  is there. He has something like a smell that is  
unique. Everything is replaceable in football  and life. With players, there is another one,  
sporting directors, managers, it happens. But  there are players that are a little bit more  
difficult because of what happens on and off the  pitch. And he helps make and protect better Phil  
and the other ones. So he makes a lot of minutes,  but I am really pleased because Kova, for example,  
Kova and Rayan Cherki, the impact in the game was  extraordinary, both. And I am really pleased for  
the contribution they have done. And obviously we  mentioned Phil and his performance. Do you think  
that is aided by what Bernardo does next to him  and how he gets him through the game? They are  
different players. Close to the box, Phil is much  better than Bernardo. To read the game globally,  
Bernardo is better. So he has to grow. Bernardo is  a grandfather already, so he is too old, and Phil  
still is a little boy. He is 24, 25 years old, so  still he has a lot to improve. Phil has to be who  
he is, that's all. And after, with his experience,  step by step. Hi, Pep. Do you think there is any  
chance Rodri might play at Wembley? Might be ready  for Wembley? No, no. I do not know. I am not sure.  
We will see in the next days. And Nico Gonzalez,  was he...? Yeah, he is fine. But I have to leave  
a lot of players out because we are all squad  ready, and sometimes they are there. But Nico,  
I have said many times, he brings us to the final  of the FA Cup, right? With a fantastic goal. And  
all the season played in that position. But in  the last game, I saw Bernie and liked a lot how  
he played there, and that is why I decided  to do it today again. Hi, Pep. Just on Phil,  
how has he been behind the scenes away from  match days, because he has not played as much  
as he would have liked to. And how big a role can  he still have to play moving forward if he signs  
a new contract? It has to be a big role in the  future. We want the best for Phil, and Phil has  
to deliver what he has done for many, many years.  So of course, he felt how people love him with the  
standing ovation for the actions. People want him  just to be happy. And at the end, the first goal,  
the second one, the control he does, how he is a  box-to-box player. He is a player with incredible  
attributes. Otherwise, he would not have been for  many years an academy player, for many years being  
here, winning six Premier Leagues, winning  all the trophies that we won together. It is  
because his contribution has been amazing. Great.  Thank you, everyone. Thank you, guys. Sleep well.
title: Pep Guardiola post-match press conference | Manchester City 3-0 Crystal Palace | Premier League
